scope: stable identities, flows, relations and failure modes for portable archive observation

identities.definition: namespace supplied by the caller for one physical archive tenant
identities.algorithm: opaque non-empty string; included in artifact identity and semantic snapshot
invariants: mandatory
prior batch must match
different archive_id values cannot share artifact IDs

identities.definition: normalized POSIX location within the explicit root
identities.algorithm: relative path, no absolute root, no empty/dot/dotdot components
invariants: stable under copying the root to another absolute location
one current artifact per path
path change is a physical change, not content identity

identities.definition: stable physical artifact identity scoped by archive and relative path
invariants: not derived from bytes
same path changing bytes retains artifact_id
same bytes at another path get another artifact_id

identities.definition: physical identity alias for the same archive/path identity
invariants: one physical location, one identity
never collapse exact duplicates by this field

identities.definition: stable external reference to a physical artifact
invariants: endpoint for relations and projections
must resolve within archive namespace
not interchangeable with content_id

identities.definition: nullable identity of observed bytes, shared by exact duplicates
invariants: not physical identity
absent for directories/symlinks/errors/specials or unreadable bytes
equal content_id does not authorize merge

identities.definition: raw content digest for readable regular files
identities.algorithm: SHA-256 of bytes observed by the observer
invariants: null is valid when content is not hashable
hash equality is byte equality only
does not prove provenance or authorship

identities.definition: semantic identity of one observation batch
identities.algorithm: snapshot:<sha256(canonical schema, archive_id, limits, semantic artifacts, observations)>
invariants: excludes absolute root
excludes wall-clock time
excludes mtime_ns from semantic artifact material
same relative content under another absolute root reproduces it
change_set is diagnostic and not part of snapshot material
candidate status only
must resolve to the current batch
duplicates are rejected
observation evidence does not promote a relation

identities.definition: incremental path comparison against an optional prior batch
invariants: sorted unique relative paths
same path with bytes changed is changed, not a new physical path
missing is prior path absent from current scan
does not mutate prior snapshot

identities.algorithm: core-specific deterministic hash over accepted unit semantics, never filename truth
invariants: provisional_unit or unresolved_unit
members and dependencies remain separate
ambiguous/unassigned partition is conserved

identities.definition: Project IR record identity for a provisional/reviewable unit
identities.algorithm: adapter/Project IR normalized identifier, not physical artifact identity
invariants: one record can reference many physical artifacts
portable SSD source is review_required
library dependencies do not become projects by default
internal evidence may carry it only when explicitly declared
no field/value/name similarity may create it
document source evidence does not prove practice fit
source_group and URL/hash/capture/license metadata required
same group/domain does not count as independent twice
source integrity is not claim truth

identities.definition: evidence-bearing claim identity in practice or research projections
invariants: supported/candidate/unknown remain distinct
supported requires explicit evidence refs
research claims never silently become practice claims

identities.definition: stable archive/artist grouping for learning split, separate from snapshot
invariants: group split prevents leakage
snapshot is never used as identity substitute
identity is not a learning feature or truth label

edges: replay -> Stage 2A candidate observations -> Stage 2B relations -> Stage 2C units -> Stage 2D Project IR
accepted Project IR -> practice_evidence_state -> opportunity_fit via explicit requirement_ids
practice + opportunity -> possibility -> product plan -> portfolio/application/research drafts
product episode -> external receipt/binding -> product_learning -> shadow-only candidate signal

relations.guard: shared bytes do not imply component relation
output filename alone does not prove manifestation
C05 export witness is not publication

relations.domain: physical_artifact or unit <-> physical_artifact or unit
relations.guard: sequence/sidecar/visual similarity are evidence, not identity
dependency is not membership or artwork
does not imply final delivery, intent or authorship

invariants: archive_id is the tenant boundary for all artifact identities
physical identity and content identity are orthogonal
same path changed bytes is one physical identity with a changed snapshot state
two exact duplicate paths are two artifacts with one shared content_id
entries without sha256 remain valid physical observations with null content_id
relative paths are POSIX and deterministic
snapshot semantic hash excludes absolute root and wall-clock time
candidate observations are not promoted truths
source provenance is carried forward, not replaced by derived labels
ambiguous and unassigned refs are explicit conservation buckets
output role requires an evidence chain, not a filename or folder guess
research evidence and practice evidence have different authorities
all external product actions remain disabled until their own gates pass
learning is shadow-only and cannot learn truth, authorship, identity or artistic worth

failure_modes.symptom: artifact_ref from archive A appears in archive B
failure_modes.fail_closed_response: reject payload/projection; never repair by content_id
reject; endpoint must resolve physical artifact_ref
retain null sha256 and kind/availability/error evidence

failure_modes.symptom: incremental scan edits old snapshot or reuses its lists
failure_modes.fail_closed_response: copy/validate prior; append current result only

failure_modes.symptom: relation/unit/claim becomes supported or active without required evidence
failure_modes.fail_closed_response: retain pending/unresolved/candidate/unknown and expose missing evidence

failure_modes.symptom: web claim is inserted as artist practice claim
failure_modes.fail_closed_response: keep environmental evidence and return unresolved practice gap
bypass optional consumer and report unavailable capability

failure_modes.symptom: ordering/IDs vary with absolute root, map order or wall clock
failure_modes.fail_closed_response: reject semantic hash or regression; no downstream ingestion
